type Node =
  | { t: 'p'; children: Inline[] }
  | { t: 'h'; level: number; children: Inline[] }
  | { t: 'ul' | 'ol'; items: Inline[][] }
  | { t: 'pre'; code: string };

type Inline =
  | { t: 'text'; s: string }
  | { t: 'code'; s: string }
  | { t: 'bold'; s: string }
  | { t: 'a'; s: string; href: string }
  | { t: 'img'; alt: string; src: string };

function parseInline(s: string): Inline[] {
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|!\[\[?[^\]]*\]\]?\([^)\s]+\)|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last, m.index) });
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push({ t: 'bold', s: tok.slice(2, -2) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push({ t: 'code', s: tok.slice(1, -1) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('![')) {
      const mm = tok.match(/^!\[(?:\[(.*?)\]|(.*?))\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/);
      out.push({ t: 'img', alt: mm?.[1] ?? mm?.[2] ?? '', src: mm?.[3] ?? '' });
    } else {
      const mm = tok.match(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/);
      out.push({ t: 'a', s: mm?.[1] ?? tok, href: mm?.[2] ?? '' });
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last) });
  return out;
}

function renderInline(nodes: Inline[], k: string | number, imgBase?: string) {
  return nodes.map((n, i) => {
    switch (n.t) {
      case 'bold': return <strong key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</strong>;
      case 'code': return <code key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</code>;
      case 'a': return <a key={`${k}-${i}`} href={n.href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{n.s}</a>;
      case 'img': {
        const src = /^https?:/.test(n.src) || n.src.startsWith('/api/')
          ? n.src
          : imgBase
            ? `${imgBase}?p=${encodeURIComponent(n.src)}`
            : n.src;
        return <img key={`${k}-${i}`} className="md-img" src={src} alt={n.alt} loading="lazy" />;
      }
      default: return <span key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</span>;
    }
  });
}

function parseBlocks(text: string): Node[] {
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const blocks: Node[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const l = lines[i];
    if (l.trim().startsWith('```')) {
      const code: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) code.push(lines[i++]);
      i++;
      blocks.push({ t: 'pre', code: code.join('\n') });
    } else if (/^#{1,3}\s/.test(l)) {
      blocks.push({ t: 'h', level: l.match(/^#+/)![0].length, children: parseInline(l.replace(/^#+\s/, '')) });
      i++;
    } else if (/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(l)) {
      const items: Inline[][] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(parseInline(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*[-*]\s+/, '')));
      blocks.push({ t: 'ul', items });
    } else if (/^\s*\d+[.、]\s+/.test(l)) {
      const items: Inline[][] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\d+[.、]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(parseInline(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*\d+[.、]\s+/, '')));
      blocks.push({ t: 'ol', items });
    } else if (l.trim() === '') {
      i++;
    } else if (/^!\[/.test(l.trim())) {
      // 独立图片行（长提示词/反馈里的附图）单独成块
      blocks.push({ t: 'p', children: parseInline(l) });
      i++;
    } else {
      const para: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() !== '' && !/^#{1,3}\s/.test(lines[i]) && !/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i]) && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) para.push(lines[i++]);
      blocks.push({ t: 'p', children: parseInline(para.join(' ')) });
    }
  }
  return blocks;
}

export function MD({ text, imgBase }: { text: string; imgBase?: string }) {
  const blocks = useMemo(() => parseBlocks(text ?? ''), [text]);
  return (
    <div className="md">
      {blocks.map((b, i) => {
        switch (b.t) {
          case 'h': {
            const Tag = (['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5', 'h6'] as const)[Math.min(5, Math.max(0, b.level - 1))];
            return <Tag key={i}>{renderInline(b.children, i, imgBase)}</Tag>;
          }
          case 'pre': return <pre key={i}>{b.code}</pre>;
          case 'ul': return <ul key={i}>{b.items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it, `${i}-${j}`, imgBase)}</li>)}</ul>;
          case 'ol': return <ol key={i}>{b.items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it, `${i}-${j}`, imgBase)}</li>)}</ol>;
          default: return <p key={i}>{renderInline(b.children, i, imgBase)}</p>;
        }
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function clip(text: string): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  return text.length > PART_CAP ? { text: text.slice(0, PART_CAP), truncated: true } : { text, truncated: false };
}

function projectPart(c: any): any | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  if (c.type === 'text') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'text', text, truncated };

export function emitEvent(taskId: string, kind: string, payload: unknown, action?: string) {
  const seq = (db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq),0)+1 AS s FROM task_events WHERE task_id=?').get(taskId) as { s: number }).s;
  const ts = Date.now();
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_events (task_id, seq, ts, kind, payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, seq, ts, kind, JSON.stringify(payload));

  if (kind === 'phase') {
    const to = (payload as { phase: string }).phase;
    const cur = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(taskId) as { status: string };
    if (to !== cur.status) {
      const finish = to === 'done' || to === 'cancelled' || to === 'failed' ? ts : undefined;
      db.prepare(
        'UPDATE tasks SET status=?, current_action=?, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, ?), finished_at=COALESCE(?, finished_at) WHERE id=?'
      ).run(to, action ?? '', ts, finish ?? null, taskId);
      publish('task.status', { taskId, to, from: cur.status });
    } else if (action) {
      db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);
    }
  } else if (action) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);
  }

  if (kind === 'planned') {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(payload), taskId);
  } else if (kind === 'step') {
    // 持久化步骤完成，保证恢复执行时不重放已完成的步骤（否则阻塞钩子会重复触发）
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT plan_json FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(taskId) as { plan_json: string | null } | undefined;
    if (row?.plan_json) {
      const plan = JSON.parse(row.plan_json) as Plan;
      const s = plan.steps?.find((x) => x.id === (payload as { id: string }).id);
      if (s) { s.done = true; db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(plan), taskId); }
    }
  } else if (kind === 'progress') {
    // P3 看板一行进度（执行/验收阶段：当前在第几步）
    const p = payload as { done: number; total: number; current: string };
    if (p && typeof p.total === 'number') {
      db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(`${p.done}/${p.total} · ${p.current}`, taskId);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'review') {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET review_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(payload), taskId);
  } else if (kind === 'asset') {
    const a = payload as { kind: string; name: string; path?: string; summary: string };
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_assets (task_id, kind, name, path_or_url, summary, at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
      taskId, a.kind ?? 'file', a.name, a.path ?? a.name, a.summary, ts
    );
  }

  publish('task.event', { taskId, event: { seq, ts, kind, payload } });
  publish('runtime.slots', runtimeStats());
}

function readFrontmatter(p: string): { name?: string; description?: string } {
  try {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').slice(0, 6000);
    const m = text.match(/^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---/);
    const fm: { name?: string; description?: string } = {};
    if (m) {
      const fmText = m[1];
      const nm = fmText.match(/^name:\s*(.+)$/m);
      const ds = fmText.match(/^description:\s*(.+)$/m);
      if (nm) fm.name = nm[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
      if (ds) {
        let d = ds[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        // YAML 块标量（>- / |）：取下一非空行
        if (/^[>|][-+]?$/.test(d)) {
          const after = ds[0].replace(/^description:/, '') + '\n' + (fmText.slice(fmText.indexOf(ds[0]) + ds[0].length));
          const line = after.split('\n').slice(1).map((x) => x.trim()).find((x) => x && !x.startsWith('#'));
          d = line ?? '';
        }
        fm.description = d;
      }
    }
    return fm;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function dirExists(p: string) {
  try { return fs.statSync(p).isDirectory(); } catch { return false; }
}

  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      const md = path.join(dir, e.name, 'SKILL.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(md)) {
        const fm = readFrontmatter(md);
        out.push({ name: fm.name ?? e.name, description: fm.description ?? '', path: path.join(e.name), source, kind: 'skill' });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function scanExtensions(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isFile() && e.name.endsWith('.ts')) out.push({ name: e.name.replace(/\.ts$/, ''), description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
    else if (e.isDirectory() && fs.existsSync(path.join(p, 'index.ts'))) out.push({ name: e.name, description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
  }
  return out;
}

export function globalItems(): { skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const skills = [
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'skills'), 'global'),
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.agents', 'skills'), 'global'),
  ];
  const extensions = scanExtensions(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions'), 'global');
  // 去重（同名保第一个）
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return {
    skills: skills.filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))),
    extensions,
  };
}

export function projectItems(dir: string): { dir: string; skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  return {
    dir,
    skills: scanSkills(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'skills'), `project:${dir}`),
    extensions: scanExtensions(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'extensions'), `project:${dir}`),
  };
}

/** 全量清单：全局 / 项目（各共享目录）/ 任务级 */
export function inventory() {
  const g = globalItems();
  const settings = getSettings();
  const base = (settings.workspacesBase as string) ?? '';
  // 项目层：只列非 fresh 工作目录（独立新目录属于任务私有，不算共享项目层）
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT DISTINCT workspace_path FROM tasks').all() as { workspace_path: string }[];
  const projects = rows
    .map((r) => projectItems(r.workspace_path))
    .filter((p) => !base || !p.dir.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase().startsWith(base.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase()));
  // 任务级
  const taskRows = db.prepare(
    'SELECT ts.*, t.title, t.board_id FROM task_skills ts JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ts.task_id ORDER BY ts.installed_at'
  ).all() as (SkillItem & { task_id: string; title: string; board_id: string })[];
  const tasks: Record<string, { title: string; boardId: string; items: SkillItem[] }> = {};
  for (const r of taskRows) {
    if (!tasks[r.task_id]) tasks[r.task_id] = { title: r.title, boardId: r.board_id, items: [] };
    tasks[r.task_id].items.push({ name: r.name, description: '', path: r.path, source: r.source, kind: r.kind as 'skill' | 'extension' });
  }
  return { global: g, projects, tasks };
}

function findItem(name: string, kind: 'skill' | 'extension', source: string): SkillItem | null {
  const inv = inventory();
  if (source === 'global') {
    return (kind === 'skill' ? inv.global.skills : inv.global.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null;
  }
  if (source.startsWith('project:')) {
    const dir = source.slice('project:'.length);
    const p = inv.projects.find((x) => x.dir === dir);
    return p ? (kind === 'skill' ? p.skills : p.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null : null;
  }
  return null;
}

function copyRecursive(src: string, dst: string) {
  const st = fs.statSync(src);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(src)) copyRecursive(path.join(src, e), path.join(dst, e));
  } else fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
}

/** 把某技能/扩展安装到任务 workspace 的 .pi/（任务级，仅该任务生效） */
export function installToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  name: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension',
  source: string
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const item = findItem(name, kind, source);
  if (!item) return { ok: false, error: `未找到 ${kind} "${name}" (source=${source})` };
  const baseDir =
    kind === 'skill'
      ? path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', item.name)
      : path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', item.path);
  if (fs.existsSync(baseDir)) return { ok: true }; // 已存在
  const srcAbs =
    source === 'global'
      ? kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'skills', item.path)
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions', item.path)
      : path.join(source.slice('project:'.length), '.pi', kind === 'skill' ? 'skills' : 'extensions', item.path);
  try {
    copyRecursive(srcAbs, baseDir);
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
    taskId, name, kind, source, item.path, Date.now()
  );
  return { ok: true };
}

export function removeTaskSkill(id: number) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').get(id) as
    | { task_id: string; name: string; kind: string; path: string }
    | undefined;
  if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'not found' };
  const task = db.prepare('SELECT workspace_path FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(row.task_id) as { workspace_path: string } | undefined;
  if (task) {
    const p =
      row.kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'skills', row.name)
        : path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'extensions', row.path);
    try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').run(id);
  return { ok: true };
}

import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { onEvent } from '../lib/ws';
import { useI18n } from '../i18n';
import KanbanBoard from '../components/KanbanBoard';
import NewTaskModal, { type SkillItem } from '../components/NewTaskModal';
import type { Task } from '../lib/types';

// 首页 = 所有项目全部任务的大看板（四阶段列，按项目分组）
export default function Boards() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[] | null>(null);
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<SkillItem[]>([]);
  const [sp, setSp] = useSearchParams();

  const load = () => api.tasksAll().then(setTasks).catch(() => {});
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    api.skills()
      .then((inv) => {
        const g: any[] = [...inv.global.skills, ...inv.global.extensions];
        const p: any[] = inv.projects.flatMap((x: any) => [...x.skills, ...x.extensions]);
        const seen = new Set<string>();
        setSkills([...g, ...p].filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))));
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return onEvent((ev) => {
      if (['task.status', 'task.created', 'boards.changed', 'task.event', 'task.deleted'].includes(ev.kind)) load();
    });
  }, []);
  // 命令面板 ?new=1：自动展开新建任务弹窗
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sp.get('new') === '1') {
      setShowNew(true);
      const p = new URLSearchParams(sp);
      p.delete('new');
      setSp(p, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [sp, setSp]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head">
        <h1>{t('boards.title')}</h1>
        <span className="sub">
          {tasks ? `${tasks.filter((x) => x.status !== 'done').length} ${t('boards.card.tasks')}` : '…'}
        </span>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <button className="btn primary" data-testid="btn-new-task" onClick={() => setShowNew(true)}>
          <Plus size={14} /> {t('board.newTask')}
        </button>
      </div>

      {!tasks ? (
        <div className="empty">{t('loading')}…</div>
      ) : tasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="empty">
          {t('tbl.empty')}
          <br />
          {t('boards.note')}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <KanbanBoard tasks={tasks} dataTestid="kanban-home" />
      )}

      {showNew && <NewTaskModal skills={skills} onClose={() => setShowNew(false)} onCreated={load} />}
    </>
  );
}

function parseInline(s: string): Inline[] {
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|!\[\[?[^\]]*\]\]?\([^)\s]+\)|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last, m.index) });
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push({ t: 'bold', s: tok.slice(2, -2) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push({ t: 'code', s: tok.slice(1, -1) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('![')) {
      const mm = tok.match(/^!\[(?:\[(.*?)\]|(.*?))\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/);
      out.push({ t: 'img', alt: mm?.[1] ?? mm?.[2] ?? '', src: mm?.[3] ?? '' });

      out.push({ t: 'a', s: mm?.[1] ?? tok, href: mm?.[2] ?? '' });
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last) });

const PART_CAP = 256 * 1024; // 单个 part 上限（防巨量工具输出刷爆 DB/事件流）

function clip(text: string): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  return text.length > PART_CAP ? { text: text.slice(0, PART_CAP), truncated: true } : { text, truncated: false };
}

function projectPart(c: any): any | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  if (c.type === 'text') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'text', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'thinking') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.thinking ?? c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'thinking', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'toolCall') {
    let args: unknown = c.arguments;
    try { if (args && typeof args === 'object') args = JSON.stringify(args, null, 2); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(args ?? ''));
    return { type: 'toolCall', id: c.id ? String(c.id) : undefined, name: c.name ? String(c.name) : 'tool', args: text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'image') return { type: 'image' };
  return null;
}

    if (to !== cur.status) {

      publish('task.status', { taskId, to, from: cur.status });
    } else if (action) {

    }
  } else if (action) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);

  if (kind === 'planned') {

export type SkillItem = { name: string; description: string; path: string; source: string; kind: 'skill' | 'extension' };

function readFrontmatter(p: string): { name?: string; description?: string } {
  try {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').slice(0, 6000);
    const m = text.match(/^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---/);
    const fm: { name?: string; description?: string } = {};
    if (m) {
      const fmText = m[1];
      const nm = fmText.match(/^name:\s*(.+)$/m);
      const ds = fmText.match(/^description:\s*(.+)$/m);
      if (nm) fm.name = nm[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
      if (ds) {
        let d = ds[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        // YAML 块标量（>- / |）：取下一非空行
        if (/^[>|][-+]?$/.test(d)) {
          const after = ds[0].replace(/^description:/, '') + '\n' + (fmText.slice(fmText.indexOf(ds[0]) + ds[0].length));
          const line = after.split('\n').slice(1).map((x) => x.trim()).find((x) => x && !x.startsWith('#'));
          d = line ?? '';
        }
        fm.description = d;
      }
    }
    return fm;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function dirExists(p: string) {
  try { return fs.statSync(p).isDirectory(); } catch { return false; }
}

/** 扫描 skill 目录：子目录含 SKILL.md，或根级 .md（.pi 系目录） */
function scanSkills(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      const md = path.join(dir, e.name, 'SKILL.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(md)) {
        const fm = readFrontmatter(md);
        out.push({ name: fm.name ?? e.name, description: fm.description ?? '', path: path.join(e.name), source, kind: 'skill' });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function scanExtensions(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isFile() && e.name.endsWith('.ts')) out.push({ name: e.name.replace(/\.ts$/, ''), description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
    else if (e.isDirectory() && fs.existsSync(path.join(p, 'index.ts'))) out.push({ name: e.name, description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
  }
  return out;
}

export function globalItems(): { skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const skills = [
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'skills'), 'global'),
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.agents', 'skills'), 'global'),
  ];
  const extensions = scanExtensions(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions'), 'global');
  // 去重（同名保第一个）
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return {
    skills: skills.filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))),
    extensions,
  };
}

export function projectItems(dir: string): { dir: string; skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  return {
    dir,
    skills: scanSkills(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'skills'), `project:${dir}`),
    extensions: scanExtensions(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'extensions'), `project:${dir}`),
  };
}

/** 全量清单：全局 / 项目（各共享目录）/ 任务级 */
export function inventory() {
  const g = globalItems();
  const settings = getSettings();
  const base = (settings.workspacesBase as string) ?? '';
  // 项目层：只列非 fresh 工作目录（独立新目录属于任务私有，不算共享项目层）
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT DISTINCT workspace_path FROM tasks').all() as { workspace_path: string }[];
  const projects = rows
    .map((r) => projectItems(r.workspace_path))
    .filter((p) => !base || !p.dir.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase().startsWith(base.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase()));
  // 任务级
  const taskRows = db.prepare(
    'SELECT ts.*, t.title, t.board_id FROM task_skills ts JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ts.task_id ORDER BY ts.installed_at'
  ).all() as (SkillItem & { task_id: string; title: string; board_id: string })[];
  const tasks: Record<string, { title: string; boardId: string; items: SkillItem[] }> = {};
  for (const r of taskRows) {
    if (!tasks[r.task_id]) tasks[r.task_id] = { title: r.title, boardId: r.board_id, items: [] };
    tasks[r.task_id].items.push({ name: r.name, description: '', path: r.path, source: r.source, kind: r.kind as 'skill' | 'extension' });
  }
  return { global: g, projects, tasks };
}

function findItem(name: string, kind: 'skill' | 'extension', source: string): SkillItem | null {
  const inv = inventory();
  if (source === 'global') {
    return (kind === 'skill' ? inv.global.skills : inv.global.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null;
  }
  if (source.startsWith('project:')) {
    const dir = source.slice('project:'.length);
    const p = inv.projects.find((x) => x.dir === dir);
    return p ? (kind === 'skill' ? p.skills : p.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null : null;
  }
  return null;
}

function copyRecursive(src: string, dst: string) {
  const st = fs.statSync(src);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(src)) copyRecursive(path.join(src, e), path.join(dst, e));
  } else fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
}

/** 把某技能/扩展安装到任务 workspace 的 .pi/（任务级，仅该任务生效） */
export function installToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  name: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension',
  source: string
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const item = findItem(name, kind, source);
  if (!item) return { ok: false, error: `未找到 ${kind} "${name}" (source=${source})` };
  const baseDir =
    kind === 'skill'
      ? path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', item.name)
      : path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', item.path);
  if (fs.existsSync(baseDir)) return { ok: true }; // 已存在
  const srcAbs =
    source === 'global'
      ? kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'skills', item.path)
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions', item.path)
      : path.join(source.slice('project:'.length), '.pi', kind === 'skill' ? 'skills' : 'extensions', item.path);
  try {
    copyRecursive(srcAbs, baseDir);
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
    taskId, name, kind, source, item.path, Date.now()
  );
  return { ok: true };
}

export function removeTaskSkill(id: number) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').get(id) as
    | { task_id: string; name: string; kind: string; path: string }
    | undefined;
  if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'not found' };
  const task = db.prepare('SELECT workspace_path FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(row.task_id) as { workspace_path: string } | undefined;
  if (task) {
    const p =
      row.kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'skills', row.name)
        : path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'extensions', row.path);
    try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').run(id);
  return { ok: true };
}

function listTaskImages(taskId: string): { num: number; name: string; path: string }[] {
  const ws = workspaceOf(taskId);

function parseInline(s: string): Inline[] {
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|!\[\[?[^\]]*\]\]?\([^)\s]+\)|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
  let last = 0;

  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last, m.index) });
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push({ t: 'bold', s: tok.slice(2, -2) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push({ t: 'code', s: tok.slice(1, -1) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('![')) {
      const mm = tok.match(/^!\[(?:\[(.*?)\]|(.*?))\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/);
      out.push({ t: 'img', alt: mm?.[1] ?? mm?.[2] ?? '', src: mm?.[3] ?? '' });
    } else {
      const mm = tok.match(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/);
      out.push({ t: 'a', s: mm?.[1] ?? tok, href: mm?.[2] ?? '' });
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last) });

}

  return nodes.map((n, i) => {

      case 'code': return <code key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</code>;
      case 'a': return <a key={`${k}-${i}`} href={n.href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{n.s}</a>;

function parseBlocks(text: string): Node[] {

const PART_CAP = 256 * 1024; // 单个 part 上限（防巨量工具输出刷爆 DB/事件流）

function clip(text: string): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  return text.length > PART_CAP ? { text: text.slice(0, PART_CAP), truncated: true } : { text, truncated: false };
}

function projectPart(c: any): any | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  if (c.type === 'text') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'text', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'thinking') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.thinking ?? c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'thinking', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'toolCall') {
    let args: unknown = c.arguments;
    try { if (args && typeof args === 'object') args = JSON.stringify(args, null, 2); } catch { /* ignore */ }

export function emitEvent(taskId: string, kind: string, payload: unknown, action?: string) {
  const seq = (db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq),0)+1 AS s FROM task_events WHERE task_id=?').get(taskId) as { s: number }).s;
  const ts = Date.now();
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_events (task_id, seq, ts, kind, payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, seq, ts, kind, JSON.stringify(payload));

  if (kind === 'phase') {
    const to = (payload as { phase: string }).phase;
    const cur = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(taskId) as { status: string };
    if (to !== cur.status) {
      const finish = to === 'done' || to === 'cancelled' || to === 'failed' ? ts : undefined;
      db.prepare(
        'UPDATE tasks SET status=?, current_action=?, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, ?), finished_at=COALESCE(?, finished_at) WHERE id=?'
      ).run(to, action ?? '', ts, finish ?? null, taskId);
      publish('task.status', { taskId, to, from: cur.status });
    } else if (action) {
      db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);
    }
  } else if (action) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);
  }

  if (kind === 'planned') {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(payload), taskId);
  } else if (kind === 'step') {
    // 持久化步骤完成，保证恢复执行时不重放已完成的步骤（否则阻塞钩子会重复触发）
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT plan_json FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(taskId) as { plan_json: string | null } | undefined;
    if (row?.plan_json) {
      const plan = JSON.parse(row.plan_json) as Plan;
      const s = plan.steps?.find((x) => x.id === (payload as { id: string }).id);
      if (s) { s.done = true; db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(plan), taskId); }
    }
  } else if (kind === 'progress') {
    // P3 看板一行进度（执行/验收阶段：当前在第几步）
    const p = payload as { done: number; total: number; current: string };
    if (p && typeof p.total === 'number') {
      db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(`${p.done}/${p.total} · ${p.current}`, taskId);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'review') {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET review_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(payload), taskId);
  } else if (kind === 'asset') {
    const a = payload as { kind: string; name: string; path?: string; summary: string };
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_assets (task_id, kind, name, path_or_url, summary, at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
      taskId, a.kind ?? 'file', a.name, a.path ?? a.name, a.summary, ts
    );
  }

  publish('task.event', { taskId, event: { seq, ts, kind, payload } });
  publish('runtime.slots', runtimeStats());
}

## Key Decisions
- **Tech stack**: Node/TS + Vite + React + node:sqlite + WebSocket (single process, port 8787)
- **Executor**: `pi --mode rpc` JSONL; each task = one subprocess; `shell:true` on win32 (`.cmd` shim) → process tree is server→cmd→pi (tree-kill needed)
- **Model**: `Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AWQ` via `fastllm` (vLLM 192.168.2.15:8080/v1); thinking arrives via openai `reasoning_content`, captured by pi in message parts
- **State machine**: `ready → queued → planning → [waiting_input] → executing → [blocked] → testing → awaiting_confirm → done`; rework: done/awaiting_confirm → queued; paused ↔ queued; **failed → queued (NEW: retry from checkpoint via /start)**
- **Block**: agent writes `work/block.json`; 1s poll; infinite wait
- **System prompt**: global → `<workspace>/.pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md`; task-specific → first user message; prefix-cache safe (append-only)
- **DB: node:sqlite** (zero native deps), WAL; migrations = `PRAGMA table_info` + `ALTER TABLE` per column (db.ts pattern)
- **Tests**: backend node:test + `TP_EXECUTOR=stub` (markers #branch/#block/#fail/#slow); UI puppeteer-core; separate `TP_DATA_DIR` tmp dirs per test server
- **P3 layout**: row-based kanban (grid `52px repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr))`), color discipline, 4-phase columns 等待/打磨/执行/验收
- **Kanban quick-action buttons must NOT navigate**; home hides done / project shows done (`showDone` prop)
- **Task detail**: `.td-body` flex row; `.td-main` (feed+actions+statusline+composer) + `aside.td-side` 340px; waiting_input = modal; full mode = `buildUnits`/`renderUnit`, summary = `EvRow`; default feed filter "all" = summary
- **Font auto-scale**: `--app-zoom` = clamp(min(vw/1440,vh/900),0.75,1.5) × fsFactor (s:1.0/m:1.06/l:1.12); `#root { zoom: var(--app-zoom); height: calc(100vh / var(--app-zoom)) }`
- **Server architecture (CONFIRMED)**: server runs from TS source (`npm start` = `node --import tsx server/src/index.ts`), serves web live from `dist/` via `express.static` → **web-only changes: `npm run build` suffices, no restart; server-code changes: restart required**. `dist/` contains only web assets (assets/ + index.html) — there is NO `dist/index.js` or `dist/server/index.js` (earlier wrong-path restart attempts failed MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
- **Windows process kill**: graceful `taskkill //PID` (no /F) is REFUSED for nohup-detached node ("只能使用强制终止"); use `taskkill //F //PID` (safe when used=0); server code has SIGINT/SIGTERM graceful handlers + `shutdownRunners()`, but hard-kill bypasses them → startup `killOrphanRunners()` is the safety net
- **Singleton guard**: one server per DATA_DIR via `data/.server.pid`; stale pidfile taken over (dead-pid probe); tests use separate tmp dirs so unaffected
- **Orphan cleanup tree-safety**: only kill `--name taskpanel-*` candidate trees whose parent chain does NOT reach own pid (prevents test servers from killing production runners); kill orphan roots only (`taskkill /F /T`)
- **Double-start prevention**: `startTask` re-checks status + runners.has (TOCTOU) — cross-process races were the real culprit (single DB, multiple servers)
- **Failed/cancelled visibility**: shown in 等待 column on BOTH boards (not hidden to history); failed tone red / cancelled gray; retry button calls `POST /tasks/:id/start` (accepts ready+failed); sorted as active (priority, created_at)
- **Real-time thinking stream**: `task.stream` bus kind (global WS seq, NOT persisted, NOT in task_events ring replay semantics); client ignores stream events with `ev.ts` older than 8s (stale replay guard — stream uses bus ts, task events use per-task seq, so seq-space comparison is invalid); live blocks keyed `block:idx`; cleared when persisted `'message'` arrives
- **Partial thinking on interruption**: runner accumulates deltas since last message_end; `flushPartial()` on closeSession (block/fail/pass paths) and stop() (pause path) → persisted `message` event `partial:true, injected:'partial'`; reset on normal message_end (no dup)
- **Summary-mode thinking**: `EvRow case 'message'` renders ONLY thinking parts as `<details open>` gray-italic block (text parts deliberately skipped — same-turn `assistant` event row already carries text; prevents duplication); full mode already renders thinking via AstUnit

export type SkillItem = { name: string; description: string; path: string; source: string; kind: 'skill' | 'extension' };

function readFrontmatter(p: string): { name?: string; description?: string } {
  try {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').slice(0, 6000);
    const m = text.match(/^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---/);
    const fm: { name?: string; description?: string } = {};
    if (m) {
      const fmText = m[1];
      const nm = fmText.match(/^name:\s*(.+)$/m);
      const ds = fmText.match(/^description:\s*(.+)$/m);
      if (nm) fm.name = nm[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
      if (ds) {
        let d = ds[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        // YAML 块标量（>- / |）：取下一非空行
        if (/^[>|][-+]?$/.test(d)) {
          const after = ds[0].replace(/^description:/, '') + '\n' + (fmText.slice(fmText.indexOf(ds[0]) + ds[0].length));
          const line = after.split('\n').slice(1).map((x) => x.trim()).find((x) => x && !x.startsWith('#'));
          d = line ?? '';
        }
        fm.description = d;
      }
    }
    return fm;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function dirExists(p: string) {
  try { return fs.statSync(p).isDirectory(); } catch { return false; }
}

/** 扫描 skill 目录：子目录含 SKILL.md，或根级 .md（.pi 系目录） */
function scanSkills(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      const md = path.join(dir, e.name, 'SKILL.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(md)) {
        const fm = readFrontmatter(md);
        out.push({ name: fm.name ?? e.name, description: fm.description ?? '', path: path.join(e.name), source, kind: 'skill' });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function scanExtensions(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isFile() && e.name.endsWith('.ts')) out.push({ name: e.name.replace(/\.ts$/, ''), description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
    else if (e.isDirectory() && fs.existsSync(path.join(p, 'index.ts'))) out.push({ name: e.name, description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
  }
  return out;
}

export function globalItems(): { skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const skills = [
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'skills'), 'global'),
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.agents', 'skills'), 'global'),
  ];
  const extensions = scanExtensions(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions'), 'global');
  // 去重（同名保第一个）
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return {
    skills: skills.filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))),
    extensions,
  };
}

export function projectItems(dir: string): { dir: string; skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  return {
    dir,
    skills: scanSkills(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'skills'), `project:${dir}`),
    extensions: scanExtensions(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'extensions'), `project:${dir}`),
  };
}

/** 全量清单：全局 / 项目（各共享目录）/ 任务级 */
export function inventory() {
  const g = globalItems();
  const settings = getSettings();
  const base = (settings.workspacesBase as string) ?? '';
  // 项目层：只列非 fresh 工作目录（独立新目录属于任务私有，不算共享项目层）
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT DISTINCT workspace_path FROM tasks').all() as { workspace_path: string }[];
  const projects = rows
    .map((r) => projectItems(r.workspace_path))
    .filter((p) => !base || !p.dir.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase().startsWith(base.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase()));
  // 任务级
  const taskRows = db.prepare(
    'SELECT ts.*, t.title, t.board_id FROM task_skills ts JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ts.task_id ORDER BY ts.installed_at'
  ).all() as (SkillItem & { task_id: string; title: string; board_id: string })[];
  const tasks: Record<string, { title: string; boardId: string; items: SkillItem[] }> = {};
  for (const r of taskRows) {
    if (!tasks[r.task_id]) tasks[r.task_id] = { title: r.title, boardId: r.board_id, items: [] };
    tasks[r.task_id].items.push({ name: r.name, description: '', path: r.path, source: r.source, kind: r.kind as 'skill' | 'extension' });
  }
  return { global: g, projects, tasks };
}

function findItem(name: string, kind: 'skill' | 'extension', source: string): SkillItem | null {
  const inv = inventory();
  if (source === 'global') {
    return (kind === 'skill' ? inv.global.skills : inv.global.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null;
  }
  if (source.startsWith('project:')) {
    const dir = source.slice('project:'.length);
    const p = inv.projects.find((x) => x.dir === dir);
    return p ? (kind === 'skill' ? p.skills : p.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null : null;
  }
  return null;
}

function copyRecursive(src: string, dst: string) {
  const st = fs.statSync(src);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(src)) copyRecursive(path.join(src, e), path.join(dst, e));
  } else fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
}

/** 把某技能/扩展安装到任务 workspace 的 .pi/（任务级，仅该任务生效） */
export function installToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  name: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension',
  source: string
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const item = findItem(name, kind, source);
  if (!item) return { ok: false, error: `未找到 ${kind} "${name}" (source=${source})` };
  const baseDir =
    kind === 'skill'
      ? path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', item.name)
      : path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', item.path);
  if (fs.existsSync(baseDir)) return { ok: true }; // 已存在
  const srcAbs =
    source === 'global'
      ? kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'skills', item.path)
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions', item.path)
      : path.join(source.slice('project:'.length), '.pi', kind === 'skill' ? 'skills' : 'extensions', item.path);
  try {
    copyRecursive(srcAbs, baseDir);
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
    taskId, name, kind, source, item.path, Date.now()
  );
  return { ok: true };
}

export function removeTaskSkill(id: number) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').get(id) as
    | { task_id: string; name: string; kind: string; path: string }
    | undefined;
  if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'not found' };
  const task = db.prepare('SELECT workspace_path FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(row.task_id) as { workspace_path: string } | undefined;
  if (task) {
    const p =
      row.kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'skills', row.name)
        : path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'extensions', row.path);
    try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').run(id);
  return { ok: true };

import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { onEvent } from '../lib/ws';
import { useI18n } from '../i18n';
import KanbanBoard from '../components/KanbanBoard';
import NewTaskModal, { type SkillItem } from '../components/NewTaskModal';
import type { Task } from '../lib/types';

// 首页 = 所有项目全部任务的大看板（四阶段列，按项目分组）
export default function Boards() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[] | null>(null);
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<SkillItem[]>([]);
  const [sp, setSp] = useSearchParams();

  const load = () => api.tasksAll().then(setTasks).catch(() => {});
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    api.skills()
      .then((inv) => {
        const g: any[] = [...inv.global.skills, ...inv.global.extensions];
        const p: any[] = inv.projects.flatMap((x: any) => [...x.skills, ...x.extensions]);
        const seen = new Set<string>();
        setSkills([...g, ...p].filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))));
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return onEvent((ev) => {
      if (['task.status', 'task.created', 'boards.changed', 'task.event', 'task.deleted'].includes(ev.kind)) load();
    });
  }, []);
  // 命令面板 ?new=1：自动展开新建任务弹窗
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sp.get('new') === '1') {
      setShowNew(true);
      const p = new URLSearchParams(sp);
      p.delete('new');
      setSp(p, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [sp, setSp]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head">
        <h1>{t('boards.title')}</h1>
        <span className="sub">
          {tasks ? `${tasks.filter((x) => x.status !== 'done').length} ${t('boards.card.tasks')}` : '…'}
        </span>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <button className="btn primary" data-testid="btn-new-task" onClick={() => setShowNew(true)}>
          <Plus size={14} /> {t('board.newTask')}
        </button>
      </div>

      {!tasks ? (
        <div className="empty">{t('loading')}…</div>
      ) : tasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="empty">
          {t('tbl.empty')}
          <br />
          {t('boards.note')}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <KanbanBoard tasks={tasks} dataTestid="kanban-home" />
      )}

      {showNew && <NewTaskModal skills={skills} onClose={() => setShowNew(false)} onCreated={load} />}
    </>
  );
}

function parseInline(s: string): Inline[] {
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|!\[\[?[^\]]*\]\]?\([^)\s]+\)|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last, m.index) });
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push({ t: 'bold', s: tok.slice(2, -2) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push({ t: 'code', s: tok.slice(1, -1) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('![')) {
      const mm = tok.match(/^!\[(?:\[(.*?)\]|(.*?))\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/);
      out.push({ t: 'img', alt: mm?.[1] ?? mm?.[2] ?? '', src: mm?.[3] ?? '' });
    } else {
      const mm = tok.match(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/);
      out.push({ t: 'a', s: mm?.[1] ?? tok, href: mm?.[2] ?? '' });
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last) });
  return out;
}

  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });

  }
  const extSrc = path.join(base, 'extensions');
  const extDst = path.join(dir, 'extensions');
  if (fs.existsSync(extSrc) && !fs.existsSync(extDst)) {
    try { fs.cpSync(extSrc, extDst, { recursive: true }); } catch { /* 忽略 */ }
  }
  let models: any = { providers: {} };
  try {
    models = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(base, 'models.json'), 'utf8'));

  const provider = models.providers?.[String(s.provider)];
  const model = provider?.models?.find((m: any) => m?.id === s.execModel);
  if (model) {

  } else if (provider) {
    provider.models = [...(provider.models ?? []), {

const PART_CAP = 256 * 1024; // 单个 part 上限（防巨量工具输出刷爆 DB/事件流）

function clip(text: string): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  return text.length > PART_CAP ? { text: text.slice(0, PART_CAP), truncated: true } : { text, truncated: false };
}

function projectPart(c: any): any | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  if (c.type === 'text') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'text', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'thinking') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.thinking ?? c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'thinking', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'toolCall') {
    let args: unknown = c.arguments;
    try { if (args && typeof args === 'object') args = JSON.stringify(args, null, 2); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(args ?? ''));
    return { type: 'toolCall', id: c.id ? String(c.id) : undefined, name: c.name ? String(c.name) : 'tool', args: text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'image') return { type: 'image' };
  return null;
}

export type SkillItem = { name: string; description: string; path: string; source: string; kind: 'skill' | 'extension' };

function readFrontmatter(p: string): { name?: string; description?: string } {
  try {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').slice(0, 6000);
    const m = text.match(/^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---/);
    const fm: { name?: string; description?: string } = {};
    if (m) {
      const fmText = m[1];
      const nm = fmText.match(/^name:\s*(.+)$/m);
      const ds = fmText.match(/^description:\s*(.+)$/m);
      if (nm) fm.name = nm[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
      if (ds) {
        let d = ds[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        // YAML 块标量（>- / |）：取下一非空行
        if (/^[>|][-+]?$/.test(d)) {
          const after = ds[0].replace(/^description:/, '') + '\n' + (fmText.slice(fmText.indexOf(ds[0]) + ds[0].length));
          const line = after.split('\n').slice(1).map((x) => x.trim()).find((x) => x && !x.startsWith('#'));
          d = line ?? '';
        }
        fm.description = d;
      }
    }
    return fm;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function dirExists(p: string) {
  try { return fs.statSync(p).isDirectory(); } catch { return false; }
}

/** 扫描 skill 目录：子目录含 SKILL.md，或根级 .md（.pi 系目录） */
function scanSkills(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      const md = path.join(dir, e.name, 'SKILL.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(md)) {
        const fm = readFrontmatter(md);
        out.push({ name: fm.name ?? e.name, description: fm.description ?? '', path: path.join(e.name), source, kind: 'skill' });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function scanExtensions(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isFile() && e.name.endsWith('.ts')) out.push({ name: e.name.replace(/\.ts$/, ''), description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
    else if (e.isDirectory() && fs.existsSync(path.join(p, 'index.ts'))) out.push({ name: e.name, description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
  }
  return out;
}

export function globalItems(): { skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const skills = [
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'skills'), 'global'),
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.agents', 'skills'), 'global'),
  ];
  const extensions = scanExtensions(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions'), 'global');
  // 去重（同名保第一个）
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return {
    skills: skills.filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))),
    extensions,
  };
}

export function projectItems(dir: string): { dir: string; skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  return {
    dir,
    skills: scanSkills(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'skills'), `project:${dir}`),
    extensions: scanExtensions(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'extensions'), `project:${dir}`),
  };
}

/** 全量清单：全局 / 项目（各共享目录）/ 任务级 */
export function inventory() {
  const g = globalItems();
  const settings = getSettings();
  const base = (settings.workspacesBase as string) ?? '';
  // 项目层：只列非 fresh 工作目录（独立新目录属于任务私有，不算共享项目层）
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT DISTINCT workspace_path FROM tasks').all() as { workspace_path: string }[];
  const projects = rows
    .map((r) => projectItems(r.workspace_path))
    .filter((p) => !base || !p.dir.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase().startsWith(base.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase()));
  // 任务级
  const taskRows = db.prepare(
    'SELECT ts.*, t.title, t.board_id FROM task_skills ts JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ts.task_id ORDER BY ts.installed_at'
  ).all() as (SkillItem & { task_id: string; title: string; board_id: string })[];
  const tasks: Record<string, { title: string; boardId: string; items: SkillItem[] }> = {};
  for (const r of taskRows) {
    if (!tasks[r.task_id]) tasks[r.task_id] = { title: r.title, boardId: r.board_id, items: [] };
    tasks[r.task_id].items.push({ name: r.name, description: '', path: r.path, source: r.source, kind: r.kind as 'skill' | 'extension' });
  }
  return { global: g, projects, tasks };
}

function findItem(name: string, kind: 'skill' | 'extension', source: string): SkillItem | null {
  const inv = inventory();
  if (source === 'global') {
    return (kind === 'skill' ? inv.global.skills : inv.global.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null;
  }
  if (source.startsWith('project:')) {
    const dir = source.slice('project:'.length);
    const p = inv.projects.find((x) => x.dir === dir);
    return p ? (kind === 'skill' ? p.skills : p.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null : null;
  }
  return null;
}

function copyRecursive(src: string, dst: string) {
  const st = fs.statSync(src);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(src)) copyRecursive(path.join(src, e), path.join(dst, e));
  } else fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
}

/** 把某技能/扩展安装到任务 workspace 的 .pi/（任务级，仅该任务生效） */
export function installToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  name: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension',
  source: string
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const item = findItem(name, kind, source);
  if (!item) return { ok: false, error: `未找到 ${kind} "${name}" (source=${source})` };
  const baseDir =
    kind === 'skill'
      ? path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', item.name)
      : path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', item.path);
  if (fs.existsSync(baseDir)) return { ok: true }; // 已存在
  const srcAbs =
    source === 'global'
      ? kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'skills', item.path)
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions', item.path)
      : path.join(source.slice('project:'.length), '.pi', kind === 'skill' ? 'skills' : 'extensions', item.path);
  try {
    copyRecursive(srcAbs, baseDir);
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
    taskId, name, kind, source, item.path, Date.now()
  );
  return { ok: true };
}

export function removeTaskSkill(id: number) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').get(id) as
    | { task_id: string; name: string; kind: string; path: string }
    | undefined;
  if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'not found' };
  const task = db.prepare('SELECT workspace_path FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(row.task_id) as { workspace_path: string } | undefined;
  if (task) {
    const p =
      row.kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'skills', row.name)
        : path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'extensions', row.path);
    try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').run(id);

export function installFileToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  rawName: string,
  content: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension'
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const base = (rawName.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? '').replace(/\.(md|ts|js)$/i, '').trim();
  const name = base.replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5-]/g, '-').replace(/-+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || `skill-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  try {
    if (kind === 'skill') {
      const dir = path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', name);
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'SKILL.md'), content, 'utf8');
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, name, 'skill', 'imported', path.join(name, 'SKILL.md'), Date.now());
    } else {
      const p = path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', `${name}.ts`);
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(p, content, 'utf8');
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, name, 'extension', 'imported', `${name}.ts`, Date.now());
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

function parseInline(s: string): Inline[] {
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|!\[\[?[^\]]*\]\]?\([^)\s]+\)|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
  let last = 0;

  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last, m.index) });
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push({ t: 'bold', s: tok.slice(2, -2) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push({ t: 'code', s: tok.slice(1, -1) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('![')) {
      const mm = tok.match(/^!\[(?:\[(.*?)\]|(.*?))\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/);
      out.push({ t: 'img', alt: mm?.[1] ?? mm?.[2] ?? '', src: mm?.[3] ?? '' });
    } else {
      const mm = tok.match(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/);
      out.push({ t: 'a', s: mm?.[1] ?? tok, href: mm?.[2] ?? '' });
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last) });

}

  return nodes.map((n, i) => {

      case 'code': return <code key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</code>;
      case 'a': return <a key={`${k}-${i}`} href={n.href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{n.s}</a>;

function parseBlocks(text: string): Node[] {

const PART_CAP = 256 * 1024; // 单个 part 上限（防巨量工具输出刷爆 DB/事件流）

function clip(text: string): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  return text.length > PART_CAP ? { text: text.slice(0, PART_CAP), truncated: true } : { text, truncated: false };
}

function projectPart(c: any): any | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  if (c.type === 'text') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'text', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'thinking') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.thinking ?? c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'thinking', text, truncated };
  }
  if (c.type === 'toolCall') {
    let args: unknown = c.arguments;
    try { if (args && typeof args === 'object') args = JSON.stringify(args, null, 2); } catch { /* ignore */ }

export function emitEvent(taskId: string, kind: string, payload: unknown, action?: string) {
  const seq = (db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq),0)+1 AS s FROM task_events WHERE task_id=?').get(taskId) as { s: number }).s;
  const ts = Date.now();
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_events (task_id, seq, ts, kind, payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, seq, ts, kind, JSON.stringify(payload));

  if (kind === 'phase') {
    const to = (payload as { phase: string }).phase;
    const cur = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(taskId) as { status: string };
    if (to !== cur.status) {
      const finish = to === 'done' || to === 'cancelled' || to === 'failed' ? ts : undefined;
      db.prepare(
        'UPDATE tasks SET status=?, current_action=?, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, ?), finished_at=COALESCE(?, finished_at) WHERE id=?'
      ).run(to, action ?? '', ts, finish ?? null, taskId);
      publish('task.status', { taskId, to, from: cur.status });
    } else if (action) {
      db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);
    }
  } else if (action) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(action, taskId);
  }

  if (kind === 'planned') {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(payload), taskId);
  } else if (kind === 'step') {
    // 持久化步骤完成，保证恢复执行时不重放已完成的步骤（否则阻塞钩子会重复触发）
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT plan_json FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(taskId) as { plan_json: string | null } | undefined;
    if (row?.plan_json) {
      const plan = JSON.parse(row.plan_json) as Plan;
      const s = plan.steps?.find((x) => x.id === (payload as { id: string }).id);
      if (s) { s.done = true; db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(plan), taskId); }
    }
  } else if (kind === 'progress') {
    // P3 看板一行进度（执行/验收阶段：当前在第几步）
    const p = payload as { done: number; total: number; current: string };
    if (p && typeof p.total === 'number') {
      db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET current_action=? WHERE id=?').run(`${p.done}/${p.total} · ${p.current}`, taskId);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'review') {
    db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET review_json=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(payload), taskId);
  } else if (kind === 'asset') {
    const a = payload as { kind: string; name: string; path?: string; summary: string };
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_assets (task_id, kind, name, path_or_url, summary, at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
      taskId, a.kind ?? 'file', a.name, a.path ?? a.name, a.summary, ts
    );
  }

  publish('task.event', { taskId, event: { seq, ts, kind, payload } });
  publish('runtime.slots', runtimeStats());
}

- **Tech stack**: Node/TS + Vite + React + node:sqlite + WebSocket (single process, port 8787)

- **Block**: agent writes `work/block.json`; 1s poll; infinite wait

- **Tests**: backend node:test + `TP_EXECUTOR=stub` (markers #branch/#block/#fail/#slow); UI puppeteer-core; separate `TP_DATA_DIR` tmp dirs per test server

- **Font auto-scale**: `--app-zoom` = clamp(min(vw/1440,vh/900),0.75,1.5) × fsFactor (s:1.0/m:1.06/l:1.12); `#root { zoom: var(--app-zoom); height: calc(100vh / var(--app-zoom)) }`
- **Server architecture (CONFIRMED)**: server runs from TS source (`npm start` = `node --import tsx server/src/index.ts`), serves web live from `dist/` via `express.static` → **web-only changes: `npm run build` suffices, no restart; server-code changes: restart required**. `dist/` contains only web assets (assets/ + index.html) — there is NO `dist/index.js` or `dist/server/index.js` (earlier wrong-path restart attempts failed MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
- **Windows process kill**: graceful `taskkill //PID` (no /F) is REFUSED for nohup-detached node ("只能使用强制终止"); use `taskkill //F //PID` (safe when used=0); server code has SIGINT/SIGTERM graceful handlers + `shutdownRunners()`, but hard-kill bypasses them → startup `killOrphanRunners()` is the safety net
- **Singleton guard**: one server per DATA_DIR via `data/.server.pid`; stale pidfile taken over (dead-pid probe); tests use separate tmp dirs so unaffected
- **Orphan cleanup tree-safety**: only kill `--name taskpanel-*` candidate trees whose parent chain does NOT reach own pid (prevents test servers from killing production runners); kill orphan roots only (`taskkill /F /T`)
- **Double-start prevention**: `startTask` re-checks status + runners.has (TOCTOU) — cross-process races were the real culprit (single DB, multiple servers)
- **Failed/cancelled visibility**: shown in 等待 column on BOTH boards (not hidden to history); failed tone red / cancelled gray; retry button calls `POST /tasks/:id/start` (accepts ready+failed); sorted as active (priority, created_at)
- **Real-time thinking stream**: `task.stream` bus kind (global WS seq, NOT persisted, NOT in task_events ring replay semantics); client ignores stream events with `ev.ts` older than 8s (stale replay guard — stream uses bus ts, task events use per-task seq, so seq-space comparison is invalid); live blocks keyed `block:idx`; cleared when persisted `'message'` arrives
- **Partial thinking on interruption**: runner accumulates deltas since last message_end; `flushPartial()` on closeSession (block/fail/pass paths) and stop() (pause path) → persisted `message` event `partial:true, injected:'partial'`; reset on normal message_end (no dup)

export type SkillItem = { name: string; description: string; path: string; source: string; kind: 'skill' | 'extension' };

function readFrontmatter(p: string): { name?: string; description?: string } {
  try {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').slice(0, 6000);
    const m = text.match(/^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---/);
    const fm: { name?: string; description?: string } = {};
    if (m) {
      const fmText = m[1];
      const nm = fmText.match(/^name:\s*(.+)$/m);
      const ds = fmText.match(/^description:\s*(.+)$/m);
      if (nm) fm.name = nm[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
      if (ds) {
        let d = ds[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        // YAML 块标量（>- / |）：取下一非空行
        if (/^[>|][-+]?$/.test(d)) {
          const after = ds[0].replace(/^description:/, '') + '\n' + (fmText.slice(fmText.indexOf(ds[0]) + ds[0].length));
          const line = after.split('\n').slice(1).map((x) => x.trim()).find((x) => x && !x.startsWith('#'));
          d = line ?? '';
        }
        fm.description = d;
      }
    }
    return fm;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function dirExists(p: string) {
  try { return fs.statSync(p).isDirectory(); } catch { return false; }
}

/** 扫描 skill 目录：子目录含 SKILL.md，或根级 .md（.pi 系目录） */
function scanSkills(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      const md = path.join(dir, e.name, 'SKILL.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(md)) {
        const fm = readFrontmatter(md);
        out.push({ name: fm.name ?? e.name, description: fm.description ?? '', path: path.join(e.name), source, kind: 'skill' });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function scanExtensions(dir: string, source: string): SkillItem[] {
  const out: SkillItem[] = [];
  if (!dirExists(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isFile() && e.name.endsWith('.ts')) out.push({ name: e.name.replace(/\.ts$/, ''), description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
    else if (e.isDirectory() && fs.existsSync(path.join(p, 'index.ts'))) out.push({ name: e.name, description: '', path: e.name, source, kind: 'extension' });
  }
  return out;
}

export function globalItems(): { skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const skills = [
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'skills'), 'global'),
    ...scanSkills(path.join(home, '.agents', 'skills'), 'global'),
  ];
  const extensions = scanExtensions(path.join(home, '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions'), 'global');
  // 去重（同名保第一个）
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return {
    skills: skills.filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))),
    extensions,
  };
}

export function projectItems(dir: string): { dir: string; skills: SkillItem[]; extensions: SkillItem[] } {
  return {
    dir,
    skills: scanSkills(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'skills'), `project:${dir}`),
    extensions: scanExtensions(path.join(dir, '.pi', 'extensions'), `project:${dir}`),
  };
}

/** 全量清单：全局 / 项目（各共享目录）/ 任务级 */
export function inventory() {
  const g = globalItems();
  const settings = getSettings();
  const base = (settings.workspacesBase as string) ?? '';
  // 项目层：只列非 fresh 工作目录（独立新目录属于任务私有，不算共享项目层）
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT DISTINCT workspace_path FROM tasks').all() as { workspace_path: string }[];
  const projects = rows
    .map((r) => projectItems(r.workspace_path))
    .filter((p) => !base || !p.dir.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase().startsWith(base.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase()));
  // 任务级
  const taskRows = db.prepare(
    'SELECT ts.*, t.title, t.board_id FROM task_skills ts JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ts.task_id ORDER BY ts.installed_at'
  ).all() as (SkillItem & { task_id: string; title: string; board_id: string })[];
  const tasks: Record<string, { title: string; boardId: string; items: SkillItem[] }> = {};
  for (const r of taskRows) {
    if (!tasks[r.task_id]) tasks[r.task_id] = { title: r.title, boardId: r.board_id, items: [] };
    tasks[r.task_id].items.push({ name: r.name, description: '', path: r.path, source: r.source, kind: r.kind as 'skill' | 'extension' });
  }
  return { global: g, projects, tasks };
}

function findItem(name: string, kind: 'skill' | 'extension', source: string): SkillItem | null {
  const inv = inventory();
  if (source === 'global') {
    return (kind === 'skill' ? inv.global.skills : inv.global.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null;
  }
  if (source.startsWith('project:')) {
    const dir = source.slice('project:'.length);
    const p = inv.projects.find((x) => x.dir === dir);
    return p ? (kind === 'skill' ? p.skills : p.extensions).find((x) => x.name === name) ?? null : null;
  }
  return null;
}

function copyRecursive(src: string, dst: string) {
  const st = fs.statSync(src);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(src)) copyRecursive(path.join(src, e), path.join(dst, e));
  } else fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
}

/** 把某技能/扩展安装到任务 workspace 的 .pi/（任务级，仅该任务生效） */
export function installToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  name: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension',
  source: string
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const item = findItem(name, kind, source);
  if (!item) return { ok: false, error: `未找到 ${kind} "${name}" (source=${source})` };
  const baseDir =
    kind === 'skill'
      ? path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', item.name)
      : path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', item.path);
  if (fs.existsSync(baseDir)) return { ok: true }; // 已存在
  const srcAbs =
    source === 'global'
      ? kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'skills', item.path)
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'extensions', item.path)
      : path.join(source.slice('project:'.length), '.pi', kind === 'skill' ? 'skills' : 'extensions', item.path);
  try {
    copyRecursive(srcAbs, baseDir);
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
    taskId, name, kind, source, item.path, Date.now()
  );
  return { ok: true };
}

export function removeTaskSkill(id: number) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').get(id) as
    | { task_id: string; name: string; kind: string; path: string }
    | undefined;
  if (!row) return { ok: false, error: 'not found' };
  const task = db.prepare('SELECT workspace_path FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(row.task_id) as { workspace_path: string } | undefined;
  if (task) {
    const p =
      row.kind === 'skill'
        ? path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'skills', row.name)
        : path.join(task.workspace_path, '.pi', 'extensions', row.path);
    try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM task_skills WHERE id=?').run(id);
  return { ok: true };
}

export function installFileToTask(
  taskId: string,
  taskWorkspace: string,
  rawName: string,
  content: string,
  kind: 'skill' | 'extension'
): { ok: boolean; error?: string } {
  const base = (rawName.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? '').replace(/\.(md|ts|js)$/i, '').trim();
  const name = base.replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5-]/g, '-').replace(/-+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || `skill-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  try {
    if (kind === 'skill') {
      const dir = path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'skills', name);
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'SKILL.md'), content, 'utf8');
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, name, 'skill', 'imported', path.join(name, 'SKILL.md'), Date.now());
    } else {
      const p = path.join(taskWorkspace, '.pi', 'extensions', `${name}.ts`);
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(p, content, 'utf8');
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO task_skills (task_id, name, kind, source, path, installed_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(taskId, name, 'extension', 'imported', `${name}.ts`, Date.now());
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { api } from '../lib/api';
import { onEvent } from '../lib/ws';
import { useI18n } from '../i18n';
import KanbanBoard from '../components/KanbanBoard';
import NewTaskModal, { type SkillItem } from '../components/NewTaskModal';
import type { Task } from '../lib/types';

// 首页 = 所有项目全部任务的大看板（四阶段列，按项目分组）
export default function Boards() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[] | null>(null);
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<SkillItem[]>([]);
  const [sp, setSp] = useSearchParams();

  const load = () => api.tasksAll().then(setTasks).catch(() => {});
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    api.skills()
      .then((inv) => {
        const g: any[] = [...inv.global.skills, ...inv.global.extensions];
        const p: any[] = inv.projects.flatMap((x: any) => [...x.skills, ...x.extensions]);
        const seen = new Set<string>();
        setSkills([...g, ...p].filter((s) => (seen.has(s.name) ? false : (seen.add(s.name), true))));
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return onEvent((ev) => {
      if (['task.status', 'task.created', 'boards.changed', 'task.event', 'task.deleted'].includes(ev.kind)) load();
    });
  }, []);
  // 命令面板 ?new=1：自动展开新建任务弹窗
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sp.get('new') === '1') {
      setShowNew(true);
      const p = new URLSearchParams(sp);
      p.delete('new');
      setSp(p, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [sp, setSp]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-head">
        <h1>{t('boards.title')}</h1>
        <span className="sub">
          {tasks ? `${tasks.filter((x) => x.status !== 'done').length} ${t('boards.card.tasks')}` : '…'}
        </span>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <button className="btn primary" data-testid="btn-new-task" onClick={() => setShowNew(true)}>
          <Plus size={14} /> {t('board.newTask')}
        </button>
      </div>

      {!tasks ? (
        <div className="empty">{t('loading')}…</div>
      ) : tasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="empty">
          {t('tbl.empty')}
          <br />
          {t('boards.note')}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <KanbanBoard tasks={tasks} dataTestid="kanban-home" />
      )}

      {showNew && <NewTaskModal skills={skills} onClose={() => setShowNew(false)} onCreated={load} />}
    </>
  );
}

type Node =
  | { t: 'p'; children: Inline[] }
  | { t: 'h'; level: number; children: Inline[] }
  | { t: 'ul' | 'ol'; items: Inline[][] }
  | { t: 'pre'; code: string };

type Inline =
  | { t: 'text'; s: string }
  | { t: 'code'; s: string }
  | { t: 'bold'; s: string }
  | { t: 'a'; s: string; href: string }
  | { t: 'img'; alt: string; src: string };

function parseInline(s: string): Inline[] {
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`|!\[\[?[^\]]*\]\]?\([^)\s]+\)|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last, m.index) });
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) out.push({ t: 'bold', s: tok.slice(2, -2) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push({ t: 'code', s: tok.slice(1, -1) });
    else if (tok.startsWith('![')) {
      const mm = tok.match(/^!\[(?:\[(.*?)\]|(.*?))\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/);
      out.push({ t: 'img', alt: mm?.[1] ?? mm?.[2] ?? '', src: mm?.[3] ?? '' });
    } else {
      const mm = tok.match(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/);
      out.push({ t: 'a', s: mm?.[1] ?? tok, href: mm?.[2] ?? '' });
    }
    last = m.index + tok.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push({ t: 'text', s: s.slice(last) });
  return out;
}

function renderInline(nodes: Inline[], k: string | number, imgBase?: string) {
  return nodes.map((n, i) => {
    switch (n.t) {
      case 'bold': return <strong key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</strong>;
      case 'code': return <code key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</code>;
      case 'a': return <a key={`${k}-${i}`} href={n.href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{n.s}</a>;
      case 'img': {
        const src = /^https?:/.test(n.src) || n.src.startsWith('/api/')
          ? n.src
          : imgBase
            ? `${imgBase}?p=${encodeURIComponent(n.src)}`
            : n.src;
        return <img key={`${k}-${i}`} className="md-img" src={src} alt={n.alt} loading="lazy" />;
      }
      default: return <span key={`${k}-${i}`}>{n.s}</span>;
    }
  });
}

function parseBlocks(text: string): Node[] {
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const blocks: Node[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const l = lines[i];
    if (l.trim().startsWith('```')) {
      const code: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) code.push(lines[i++]);
      i++;
      blocks.push({ t: 'pre', code: code.join('\n') });
    } else if (/^#{1,3}\s/.test(l)) {
      blocks.push({ t: 'h', level: l.match(/^#+/)![0].length, children: parseInline(l.replace(/^#+\s/, '')) });
      i++;
    } else if (/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(l)) {
      const items: Inline[][] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(parseInline(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*[-*]\s+/, '')));
      blocks.push({ t: 'ul', items });
    } else if (/^\s*\d+[.、]\s+/.test(l)) {
      const items: Inline[][] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\d+[.、]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(parseInline(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*\d+[.、]\s+/, '')));
      blocks.push({ t: 'ol', items });
    } else if (l.trim() === '') {
      i++;
    } else if (/^!\[/.test(l.trim())) {
      // 独立图片行（长提示词/反馈里的附图）单独成块
      blocks.push({ t: 'p', children: parseInline(l) });
      i++;
    } else {
      const para: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() !== '' && !/^#{1,3}\s/.test(lines[i]) && !/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i]) && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) para.push(lines[i++]);
      blocks.push({ t: 'p', children: parseInline(para.join(' ')) });
    }
  }
  return blocks;
}

export function MD({ text, imgBase }: { text: string; imgBase?: string }) {
  const blocks = useMemo(() => parseBlocks(text ?? ''), [text]);
  return (
    <div className="md">
      {blocks.map((b, i) => {
        switch (b.t) {
          case 'h': {
            const Tag = (['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5', 'h6'] as const)[Math.min(5, Math.max(0, b.level - 1))];
            return <Tag key={i}>{renderInline(b.children, i, imgBase)}</Tag>;
          }
          case 'pre': return <pre key={i}>{b.code}</pre>;
          case 'ul': return <ul key={i}>{b.items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it, `${i}-${j}`, imgBase)}</li>)}</ul>;
          case 'ol': return <ol key={i}>{b.items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it, `${i}-${j}`, imgBase)}</li>)}</ol>;
          default: return <p key={i}>{renderInline(b.children, i, imgBase)}</p>;
        }
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function clip(text: string): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  return text.length > PART_CAP ? { text: text.slice(0, PART_CAP), truncated: true } : { text, truncated: false };
}

function projectPart(c: any): any | null {
  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null;
  if (c.type === 'text') {
    const { text, truncated } = clip(String(c.text ?? ''));
    return { type: 'text', text, truncated };
